description: Alvarado-Vicencio, Reginald at RWTH Aachen University publishes data supporting controlled laboratory tests of polyurethane-based permeable pavement clogging through Co-UDlabs. The deposit bundles the study data, Python plotting code and a FreeCAD design for a printed tray separating filtered water from overflow. The plotting code and tray design are supporting components of the same experiment. Coverage is laboratory pavement tests; locations within the apparatus and observation periods are unspecified. Zenodo provides a data archive and descriptive documentation with free access under CC BY 4.0. These observations support the source-defined drainage measurement, physical-model or simulation activity. Related Co-UDlabs experiments describe other assets and test conditions; they are not assumed to be independent or interchangeable measurements. A limitation is the source does not enumerate hydraulic variables, clogging loads or repetitions, and separate component code licences are not listed. Only native metadata and file descriptors were read; no data values, archive, code or report body was obtained.
